name: Early Click Buffer
description: Click a hair too early and your input waits a few ticks until it won't kill you.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the buffer on or off. When off, every input goes straight through.

max-delay.name: Max Delay (ticks)
max-delay.description:
The most a click can be held back. GD runs <cy>240 ticks per second</c>, so <cy>4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS</c>.

2 = barely noticeable, 6 = forgiving, 12+ = very forgiving (can feel floaty).

buffer-wave-releases.name: Buffer Wave Releases
buffer-wave-releases.description: In wave, letting go at the wrong moment kills you just like pressing does. Turn this off to only touch presses.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (ticks)
lookahead.description: How far ahead a cube/ball/robot/spider jump is checked. Checking usually ends sooner, as soon as the jump lands or reaches the next orb.

time-budget.name: Time Budget (ms)
time-budget.description: Most time one click may spend predicting. If it runs out, the click goes through normally. Raise it if saves miss on heavy levels; lower it if clicking causes stutter.

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Shows the max delay in the top-left corner while playing, plus how many ticks the last saved click was held.

log-saves.name: Log Saved Clicks
log-saves.description: Writes a line to the Geode console every time a click is held back.
